blind.description: A curved hunting horn or war horn mounted to a small wooden wall plaque via red straps and a metal bracket. The horn itself is cream-colored with dark brown near the pointed tip, fitted with studded brass or gold bands around the wide mouth and tip. It rests directly on the ground on its curved underside and attached mounting plaque, without an extra base plinth. All surfaces are smooth, solid, and stylized.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an elongated tapered horn shape lying horizontally, with the wide circular opening on the left and the narrow pointed tip on the right, connected via red bands to a small wooden plaque extending upward.
defects: Intended as a wall-mounted prop, so it rests awkwardly on its side on the ground plane
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/7 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 9 to 10 inches tall resting on the floor) and about 1.5 feet in length.

notes: Rests on floor as it is designed for wall mounting
Mounted to a small wooden plaque rather than hanging freely from a hook
footprint proportion 1.69x off the catalog (1.2 x 0.4 ft)
